decision: keep WSS+imsg rpc; do not migrate from BlueBubbles or replace the data plane with SSH
why: this repo already wraps steipete imsg rpc over mTLS WSS; imsg has watch.subscribe not webhooks; SSH is setup-only and would lose FDA/allowlist
transport is ADR 001; overflow resume is specified by imsg watch/rpc docs; a second arena would be extra design over a settled shape

decision: workspace cargo test on the working tree was red on slow_response_does_not_hold_the_stdin_lock
why: the concurrency test raced Python startup and used a 150ms budget

decision: map native watch.overflow to Gap watch_overflow and clear watch_subscription so ensure_watch resubscribes
why: imsg docs say overflow is terminal; dropping it left the live tail dead; Linux already catch-up on watch.gap

decision: make rustls install ignore a second provider and init tracing once in the unified CLI
why: imsg bridge serve called install_default twice and tracing init twice and would panic
result: VERIFIED unit test plus imsg --json info
